examples.title: Combine two deep streams
examples.code:
# Combine all samples from two deep images.
deep_merge = nuke.createNode("DeepMerge2")
deep_merge.setInput(0, deep_a)
deep_merge.setInput(1, deep_b)
deep_merge["operation"].setValue("combine")

examples.title: Use one deep stream as a holdout
examples.code:
# Hold out samples in B using the samples in A.
deep_merge = nuke.createNode("DeepMerge2")
deep_merge.setInput(0, holdout)
deep_merge.setInput(1, deep_image)
deep_merge["operation"].setValue("holdout")

# Configure the "metainput" control.
deepMerge2 = nuke.createNode("DeepMerge2")
deepMerge2["metainput"].setValue("A")
